name: Citizenship by Registration -- Born in The Bahamas to Non-Bahamian Parents

qualifying_event.description: A person born in The Bahamas after 9 July 1973 to non-Bahamian parents may apply for registration as a citizen (Form II or III).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate showing birth in The Bahamas after 9 July 1973; proof of parents' non-Bahamian nationality.

requirements.blocker_text: Must have been born in The Bahamas after 9 July 1973 (Bahamian independence) to non-Bahamian parents.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate (born in The Bahamas after 9 July 1973)
Police certificate (within 6 months, covering 5 years, if 14+)
Two character references (from a Bahamian knowing applicant 5+ years)

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Pathways to Bahamian Citizenship: registration route (Form II/III) for persons born in The Bahamas after 9 July 1973 to non-Bahamian parents; Form VI available if deadlines were missed for applicants from non-Commonwealth countries

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. This is a conditional jus soli route (birth in the territory) rather than a descent/ancestry route, since the parents are non-Bahamian -- categorised as 'settled' rather than 'ancestry' for that reason. The source mentions an application-timing/deadline system (with Form VI as a late-application fallback for applicants from non-Commonwealth countries) but does not give the specific deadline (commonly cited elsewhere as needing to apply between ages 18-21, though not confirmed on this tier-1 source) -- flagged as a gap rather than assumed.
